name: Kablam-O
source:
Team Kablam-O is actually made up of two people -- these kids Marny and Ricky -- and they pilot a freaking battle mech! It's totally nuts! I know them from Study Hall, where Marny is most often being really loud, and Ricky tries to quiet her down... badly. They seem to like Nice people.

[From in-game profile]
